helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  arealinks
 
Shows you all of the inter-area room links to the area you are currently in.
It doesn't check scripts (e.g. if a NPC or room transfers you to another area, it
won't show up in arealinks).

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  autosetname
{x
Toggles automatic keyword setting on or off. When autosetname is ON, object
and mobile name-keywords will be automatically set when you set the short
desc (it takes the short desc and removes things such as colour codes, "a",
"the", etc.). After the keywords are autoset, you can still change them
using the "name" command.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  clone <object>
{x  clone <mobile>

Duplicates an object or mobile. Not very useful.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  evict <person name>
{x
Clears a PC's link to a home, if they are evicted they won't
be able to use gohome to recall there anymore. Note, however,
that the home itself is still there.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  goto <room vnum>
{x  goto <character keyword>
{x  goto <object keyword>
 
The goto command warps you instantly to a location of your choice.

helps.creator: Tieryo
helps.text:
Syntax:
  holyaura
 
Toggles the holyaura mode. Holyaura allows you to:
- Issue ship commands as if you were the ship owner.
- Ignore safe room restrictions.
- Resurrect non-cpk corpses in cpk rooms (why?)

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  holylight
{x
Toggles the holylight mode. Holylight allows you to:
- See room vnums automatically
- Never need a light source
- Can automatically see everyone except higher level
{x  wizinvis imms
{x
It's generally a good idea to keep this on unless you are
testing something.

helps.creator: Tieryo
helps.text:
Syntax:
  holywarp
 
Toggles the holywarp mode. Holywarp allows you to:
- Ignore area locking restrictions.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  housemove <person> <room vnum>
{x
Changes a person's home-recall spot to the given vnum.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  immtalk
{x  immtalk <string>
{x  : <string>
{x
Lets you communicate with the rest of the immortal world on
the immortal channel in all of its blue-green glory. Typing
it without an argument turns it on and off.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  incog <level>

Incog is identical to the wizinvis except that characters in your room can
still see you. Good for testing stuff such as mobile scripts in your area which
require you to be vis while avoiding the masses.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  load object <vnum> <amt>
{x  load mobile <vnum>

This creates a new instance of an object or mobile based on 
an existing template (vnum). To discourage would-be-cheaters,
we remind you that all loads are logged and all loaded objects
have your name on them.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  mlevel <level>
{x
Shows you a listing of what mobiles are of a certain level.
Not very useful, except for helping mortals.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  m/o/rpdump <prog vnum>
{x
Shows you the raw code for a script vnum. Usually
used in conjunction with m/o/rpstat.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  m/o/rpstat <mob/obj keyword or room vnum>
{x
Shows you a listing of all of the scripts attached to
a mobile, object, or room as well as their triggers and
phrases. Very handy for scripting and debugging.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  m/o/rwhere <mob/obj/room keyword>
{x
Looks up whether a mobile, object, or room is currently
in the game. Contrast this with the "vnum" command which
looks up a mob/obj/room template.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  nochannels <person>
{x
Takes away a PC's public channels until somebody (or you) decides to
give them back. Do not use lightly as it will result in backlash,
i.e. lots of annoying whining.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  notell <person>
{x
Takes away a person's ability to send tells, until you or
someone else decides to give them back. Use with caution.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  olevel <min> <max> <type> <wear_loc>
{x
Slightly more useful than mlevel. It looks up an object currently
in the game with a min and max level range, an item type, and a
wear location. The last two arguments are optional.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  otransfer <object keyword> <location>
{x
Transfer an object just like you would a character. The object
has to be in a room, not in someone's inventory or in a container.
Usually for things like relics which you don't want to purge and
re-load for various code reasons.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  peace
{x
Stops all fighting in the room you are in, and removes the agressive
flag from all mobiles in the room.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  poofin <string>
{x  poofout <string>
{x
Sets a variable message to be sent to players in the room on
your arrival and departure. The string must have your name in
it.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  purge
{x  purge <object keyword>
{x  purge <NPC keyword>
{x
Vaporizes an object or NPC into thin air. Purge without an
argument will clear the whole room of everything in it (except
PCs).

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  restore
{x  restore all (level 153 and above only)
{x  restore <character>
{x
Restores the victim(s) from the dead to full health, mana
and move, and wipes away all the common maladies (poison, etc).
Please note that all restores are logged; don't try to cheat
using them.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  string <name/short/long> <string>
{x
Changes an object's name keywords, short description, or
long description. This is the imm version of the restring
command, free of charge.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  transfer <person>
{x  transfer <person> <location>
{x
Yanks someone rudely away from what they are doing and brings
them to a location of your choice (a room vnum, object name, or
character name can be specified for location, just like with goto).
If no location is specified, it brings them to your room.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  uninvis <command>
{x  ^<command>
{x
Lets you go un-wizi/un-incog just for the duration of one command. Good
for tossing in snide remarks over gossip, then disappearing once again :>

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  vislist
{x  vislist <person>
{x  vislist clear
{x
Adds/removes someone to your vislist. The people on your
vislist can see you even when you are wizinvis, incog,
or what have you.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  vnum <keyword>
{x  vnum <obj/mob> <keyword>
{x
Looks up the template (vnum) from a keyword. For extra
specificity, you can specify whether you want to find
an object or a mob.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  wizhelp
{x
Shows you the immortal commands available to you at your level.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  wizinvis
{x  wizinvis <level>
 
Wizinvis hides you from all NPCs and all PCs below your invisibility level.
You can still choose to be visible to the people on your vislist.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  wiznet
{x  wiznet status
{x  wiznet show
{x  wiznet <feature>
{x
Allows you to turn wiznet on/off (no argument), show
what features you have enabled (status), show all the features
available to you (show), or toggle a single feature on/off.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  zot <person>
{x  zot room (implementor only)
{x
Delivers a powerful bolt of lightning which knocks your
poor victim down to 1hp, 1mana, and 1move. Great as a
warning to unruly crowds.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  botter <person>
{x
Sets a person with a [BOTTER] tag, visible on who.
Meant as punishment by riducule. A botter flag is essentially
a PK flag: it lets anyone PK the victim.
{x
Please make sure you have just cause before sticking this
on someone.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  pecho <player> <string>
{x
Echoes a string to a single player. Good for messing with
people. Immortals higher level than you get a pecho> prefix
before the string.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  switch <NPC>
{x  return
{x
Lets you play around as an NPC until you get tired of it.

helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  zecho <string>
{x
Echoes a string to everyone in your area. Immortals
higher-level than you see a zecho> prefix.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  gecho <string>
{x
Sends a string to the whole wide world. Higher-level immortals
get a gecho> prefix before the string.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  junk <person> <obj vnum or name> [all]
{x
Strips a character of an object, which you can specify
by vnum or name. If the "all" argument is added, it will
junk ALL instances of the item rather than just the first
one. Doesn't look in containers.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  newlock
{x
Locks out new characters from the game: i.e. until newlock
is toggled off, no more newbies can be made. Use it if some
hooligan keeps making trouble with new characters. Do NOT
forget to turn it off.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  slay <person>
{x
Lops off a person's head in cold blood, sending them on an
unpleasant ride to the netherworld. Use very sparingly, as
zots are preferred.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  allow <address>
{x
Allows a banned person back into the good graces of Sentience.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  assignhelper <person>
{x
Gives the person a "helper" flag, which lets them see the helper
channel but doesn't do much else for them. Only give it to people
you are sure will be helpful to newbies.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  ban <site> <newbies/all>
{x
Bans someone's site temporarily. Avoid using this unless absolutely 
necesarry. If you feel you must use it, ban newbies from the site
first.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  force <person> <action>
{x  force room <action>
{x  force all <action>
{x
Forces someone to do whatever you want them to. Very
fun to use, but take care not to piss anyone off.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  freeze <person>
{x
Freezes or thaws a character. If frozen, they can sign in but
do nothing else.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  reckoning
{x
Starts The Reckoning.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  sockets
{x  sockets <person>
{x
Shows you the IP addresses of everyone who's playing, or
of a single person. Often used to spot multiplaying and
other forms of cheating, or to ban someone.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  deny <person>
{x
Locks someone out of their char, which has to be edited through
shell for them to be able to play again. Pretty pointless as we
have the freeze command which is just as good and more easily
undoable.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  immortalise <person>
{x  immortalise <person> <subclass>
{x

shows you the subclasses they can pick. BE SURE they have
completed all 4 classes before remorting and have the
4 remort runes. The runes are just cosmetic, but remorting
someone with incomplete classes will lead to many, many
headaches later on.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  log <person>
{x
Sets perm-log on someone. The logs can later be viewed through
shell. This is only really used on immortals, although extremely
shady players have gotten it too.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  permban <site> <newbies/all>
{x
Permanently bans a site. Avoid doing this unless it's
absolutely necesarry.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:

{x  set obj   <name> <field> <value>

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  snoop <person>
{x  snoop self (to cancel)
{x

it's for diagnostic needs only.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  wizlock
{x

set this on without a good reason, and don't ever forget to turn
it off.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  xpboost <# of minutes|off>
{x
Turn double experience on or off. Use sparingly.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  advance <person> <class level>
{x

It tries to compensate for the stats they would have
gained (and fails miserably).

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  alevel <person>
{x
Advance a person one level exactly.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  areset <area keyword>
{x

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  besteq <level>
{x

works, kinda doesn't.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  disconnect <person>
{x

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  protect <person>
{x

Syntax: alias
{X        alias <word>
{X        alias <word> <substitution>
{X        unalias <word>{X

The alias command allows limited shortening of command names.  At
this time, aliases cannot call other aliases, and cannot generate
more than one command. Alias by itself lists your current aliases,
Alias <word> lists the alias with that name (if such exist), and
alias with both a word and and argument produces a new alias.  You
cannot alias either alias or unalias to a new command.  Examples of
use:

alias gc get all corpse  --> typing gc will equal typing 'get all corpse'
alias ff cast 'fireball' --> ff orc will equal 'cast 'fireball' orc'

Only the first word on the line will be subsituted.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Sentience uses various automatic actions, to ease the boredom
of always splitting gold and sacrificing corpses. The commands 
are as follows:
 
autolist     : lists all automatic actions
autoloot     : takes all equipment from dead mobiles
autogold     : takes all gold from dead mobiles
autosac      : sacrifices dead monsters (if autoloot is on,
               only empty corpses).
autoexit     : display room exits upon entering a room.
autosplit    : splits up spoils from combat among your group
               members.
autoassist   : makes you help group members in combat
battlespam   : toggles whether you see messages from other 
               people's battle.
challenge    : toggles whether people can challenge you or not
nosummon     : toggles whether people can summon you
nofol        : splits up your formation, ditches any followers
formstate    : toggles whether or not you see form health info in combat
 
typing a command sets the action, typing it again removes it.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: bank balance
bank deposit <amount>
bank withdraw <amount>
bank wire <amount> <person>

The banks in Seralia offer accounts to adventurers so they may
store their money in a safe place and not worry about it being
looted. Banks only accept gold; to convert silver to gold, just 
give it to the banker and you will receive the proper amount of 
change minus a small service fee. 

BANK BALANCE: shows you the amount of gold in your bank account.
BANK DEPOSIT: deposits the specified amount of gold coins.
BANK WITHDRAW: withdraws the specified amount of gold coins.
BANK WIRE: transfer gold between bank accounts.

helps.text:
Allows you to send notes to any player on Sentience.
Every time you log on, you are notified of any unread notes that
you have. The note commands are:

         note list            : shows all of the notes available to read.
         note read #          : shows a particular note to you.
         note to <name>       : starts a blank note to somebody.
         note clear           : deletes a note in progress.      
         note subject <string>: sets the note's subject.
         note edit            : opens the editor for writing notes.
         note post            : posts the note currently in progress.
         note show            : shows note being written.
 
Addressing a note to 'immortal' sends it to all immortals.
Feel free to use notes to report bugs. Admin related questions
(bug reports and new ideas) should be directed to Syn, Whisp, or Jesterman.

Syntax: prompt
{X        prompt all
{X        prompt <%*>
{X
Allows you to turn your prompt on or off, or customize it.
Simply typing 'prompt' will switch your prompt on and off.
{X
'prompt all' will set your prompt to show the standard 'hp/mp/mv'.
{X
'prompt <%*>' allows you to set many independent variables:
{X
{X        %h : Your current hits
{X        %m : Your current mana
{X        %v : Your current moves
{X        %H : Your maximum hits
{X        %M : Your maximum mana
{X        %V : Your maximum moves
{X        %x : Your current experience
{X        %X : Your experience till next level
{X        %g : Your gold held
{X        %s : Your silver held
{X        %a : Your alignment
{X        %r : The room name you are in
{X        %e : Your current room's exits in a NWSEUD fashion
{X        %c : A carriage return (a newline, for multi-line prompts)
{X        %w : Current weight you are carrying
{X        %W : Max weight you can carry
{X        %q : Quest points
{X        %Q : Quests completed
{X        %p : Practices
{X        %P : Pneuma
{X        %t : Trains
{X        %b : Bank balance
{X        %C : Weight of carried coins
{X
You may use ANSI color codes in your prompt. (HELP COLOR)
For example, typing 'prompt <%h/%Hhp %m/%Mmp %v/%Vmv %Xxp>'
Would show you '<500/500hp 1000/1000mp 1000/1000mv 50000xp>'
as your prompt.

helps.text:
Syntax:
{x  skills [skill name]
{x
Skills are special abilities known by the denizens
of Sentience. Each profession gets a set of skills, and
by multiclassing you can accumulate a large number of
them. Most races also have one or more skills which are
unique to them.
{x
Mundane skills, like weapons, do not require mana to use. 
Skills which are magical in nature or require an investment
of energy (for example, the lich skill scry) may use mana.
Almost all skills cost movement to use.
{x
Your proficiency at a skill is measured by a percentage
1-100%. All but the most common skills start at 1%. You can 
practice them at a trainer to increase your proficiency.
However, you can only increase a skill to 75% by practicing
it, as there is only so much a trainer can teach you. 
 
To get a skill to 100% (master), you must use it in the
field. Some skills are easier to master than others. Note
that even being a master at a skill does not guarantee its
impeccable success - even the best of the best screw up
sometimes.
{x
The following skills are known to all races and professions
in Sentience: 
{x
hand to hand, scrolls, single weapon style, staves, wands
{x
To learn more about a specific skill, type help <skill name>.

Syntax:
{x cast 'enchant armor' <object>
{x cast 'enchant weapon' <object>
 
Enchanting is a druid magical ability in which he/she links the forces
of nature to the magical affects of an object, improving their
benefits. However, there is an inherent risk in this process
because sometimes the natural forces will break loose and either
strip the magical affects completely off the object or destroy
it completely.
 
The only types of items that can be enchanted are armor and weapon
with the enchant armor and enchant weapon spell, respectively.

        c 'acid blast' 
{X
{YLevel (mage classes): {W16{X
{YBase cost:{W 20 mana{X
{YType:{W Offensive Spell{X

Many mages around the world use this very devestating spell.
It's the choice of many, for it's ability to brutalize an 
opponent in the blink of an eye. One will channel their inner
energies, then release it upon a victim, shooting a stream of 
acid from their hand at an opponent. 
 
Note: There's a chance that acid blast will also destroy the
eq of your opponent, and also the chance that it will destoy
yours as well.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'afterburn' <direction>

Afterburn is a mighty spell that shows the awesome power of the wizard. 
Casting the spell, they summon a mighty fireball of wizard's fire and hurl
it several rooms, causing severe damage to anything or anyone who might lie
in its way.  The fireball eventually runs out of energy and explodes in a
scathing inferno.  People that the Wizard wouldn't normally be able to
attack are not affected by its flames.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'animate dead' <target>
 
Animate dead is a very dark and mysterious spell
very few actually use for what it is capable of.
After a create has been slain, a very skilled
spell caster may chant words over the corpse, thus
bringing their slain opponent back from death, in
turn becomming undead and under the control of the
spell caster for the duration of the spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'armor' <target>
        c 'armor' 
 
All spell casters all over the world use this very
useful spell to aid them through whatever may lie 
before them. This spell when casted forms a light 
layer over the caster's body, protection them from
harms, thus raising their defenses. This spell may
also be casted on others as well.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The adept spell 'avatar shield' reduces damage from all evil characters
by 10% when the player is affected by it.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'bless' <target>
        c 'bless'
 
All spell casters all over the world use this 
very useful spell. By chanting a few words to 
the higher powers, this spell will provide them
with holy protection from all that surrounds 
them. Thus, aiding in their resistance to harm
from spells and raising their armor slightly

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'blindness' <target>
        c 'blindness' 
 
Blindness is a sorcerer's best, and many use it quite 
often for it's fast way to disable an opponent's sight,
thus giving them the advantage to a battle. A skilled 
mage will cast this at an opponent, disrupting their 
eyesight for the duration of the spell, or until they
cast cure blind.
 
See also: CURE BLIND

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'burning hands' <target>
        c 'burning hands'
 
Burning hands is an ancient spell of a spell caster's
knowledge. It has come in handy for many spell casters 
previous for it's ability to save their life in 
moments of perile. Their hands will burn alive with 
energy and they will grab ahold of their opponent, 
shocking them and in turn killing them. It does not
require a lot of mana and it's prooven very useful.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax c 'call familiar'
 
Call familiar is the powerful Ranger spell in which will
allow one skilled in this to call upon the powers of the
forests, providing the caster with a mobile 1/2 to 
9/10's the current rager's level/report. Thus, it will 
aid the caster for the duration of the spell, only to 
return back home when it's done.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'call lightning' <target>
 
Call lightning is a very useful spell to spell 
casters who go on many journies. Many use this
spell for it's ability to deal out heavy damage
in a short amount of time. While in the wilderness
a spell caster will raise there hand making storms
brew in the heavens, then, they will call down
a very large lightning bolt to strike their 
opponents dead.
 
note: Call lightning will only work in the wilderness.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:

Calm stops combat in the room for everyone who is not affected by the calm spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cancellation' <target>
        c 'cancellation'
 
Cancellation is a very powerful spell that many 
mages use. Having been around for a very long 
time, many mages use this in battle, to help aid
them against their enemy. By honing a little of
their magical power, this spell allows them to 
strip the effects off of an opponent, making it
easy for them to kill the opponent.
 
Note: Cancellation can only be used against
other players and does not initiate combat.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast <spell> <target>
 
Casts a magical spell. Spells with more then one word must be 
enclosed in quotes.
 
Example: cast 'burning hands' knight

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cause critical' <target>
        c 'cause critical'
 
This spell allows a spell caster to cause critical
damage, thus critically injuring their opponent. 
While this spell is not used widely, it has been
known to save the life of a caster more times then
one.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cause light' <target>
        c 'cause light'
 
Many spell casters use this spell to quite simply 
warn their opponent of the deadly magical power
they possess. It costs little mana for them to cast
and does little damage, but is very effective more
times then not.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cause serious' <target>
        c 'cause serious'
 
Cause serious is an age old favorite for many 
spell casters, for it's ability to do very serious
damage to their opponent with very little effort
on behalf of the caster.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'chain lightning' <target>
        c 'chain lightning'
 
Chain lightning is a extremely powerful mage spell
and used world wide by all spell casters. A skilled
mage will channel his powers, then unleash it, thus
controlling the power of lightning and unleashing a 
chain reaction of lightning bolts, slaughtering 
anyone caught in the spell caster's way.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:

Charm person is a very wicked spell in where the 
caster may take control over a monster or 
player. When casted, they will come under the 
control of the spell caster for the duration of 
the spell, ending in doing the bidding of the 
caster.

helps.creator: none

Syntax: c 'chill touch' <target>
        c 'chill touch'
 
This is a mild spell, widely used by spell casters.
A spell caster will slow the air around them, thus
making their hands freeze and grasping their enemy
with them, chilling them to the bone, damaging them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cloak of guile'
 
Truely a powerful spell, cloak of guile when 
casted will hide the caster, with a powerful
effect, making them appear invisible. This
will last for the duration of the spell, and
won't come off when the player moves. 
 
Note: You may still be seen if someone is 
effected by detect invis.
 
See also: DETECT INVIS

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'colour spray' <target>
        c 'colour spray'
 
Colour spray is a very great and widely used spell
by most spell casters. Many favor this spell for 
it's great power against any race harmed by light.
Another reason spell casters like this spell is 
it's ability to blind their opponents on occasion.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'continual light' <object>
        c 'continual light' 
 
When casted, continual light will provide a 
traveler with a light source, thus giving them
a way through the night. In turn, if casted on
an object, it will bless it with the powers of
the heavens, stopping it from decaying as fast.
This is a very frequently used spell by all 
spell casters.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'control weather' better
        c 'control weather' worse
 
Control weather is a very powerful spell where a 
spell caster, after summoning enough energy may 
manipulate the skies above him, thus giving either
better weather, or worse aiding him in his travels.
Depending on how knowledge one is in this, 
determines how well they may manipulate the skies 
above them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cosmic blast' <target>
 
Cosmic blast is a powerful spell that allows one
to call fourth a cosmic blast, obliterating their
opponents. Upon a successful casting, the caster 
also has the ability to blind their opponent. The
more skilled one is in this, the better the chance
they have for the spell to blind their opponent.
 
See also: CURE BLIND

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'counterspell'
 
Counterspell is an extremely powerful spell. Normally in
combat when a spell it is cast, spell casters will cast
this spell after the opponent has casted theirs. This will
then cause the spell to backfire, and anything the caster
intended to hit will thus be shot back at him, hitting him
with anything he was trying to cast.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'create food'
 
When hungry on the road, and the traveler is out
of provisions, many will call upon this spell to
stay alive. By chanting a simple saying, food 
appear out of nowhere so that they may sustain 
their life another day. It does not take a lot of
energy to use and works very well.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'create rose'
 
Many mages use this, either to give to a fare lady 
or to give to a friend. When casted, this will 
create for the caster a beautifully carved wooden
rose.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'create spring'
 
When thirsty and a traveler is out of water for 
control of their thirsty, they rely on this spell,
create water. By casting this, a magical spring 
will appear in the room of the traveler, providing
fresh and clean water for them to drink.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'create water' <container>
 
When thirsty and a traveler's decanter is empty, 
many spell casters turn to this spell for support.
With very little energy, a spell caster can turn
a once empty decanter, flask, etc into a full 
water source to aid them on their journey.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure blindness' <target>
        c 'cure blindness'
 
Probably one of the most useful spells in history, mages
and clerics all over the world rely on this great spell
to get them through thick or thin. Whenever one is 
blinded they turn to this spell first and foremost to
cure it.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure critical' <target>
        c 'cure critical'
 
Many spell casters all over the world use this ancient 
spell. It has been around since the dawning of time, and
when casted, this spell will help heal one from critical
injury.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure disease' <target>
        c 'cure disease'
 
Disease and illness is an unavoidable cause in life.
Though, when diseased, a skilled spell caster will 
call upon the power's assisstance, in turn aiding 
and curing them from all sickness. The higher one is
skilled in this, the better their chance at curing 
their disease.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure light' <target>
        c 'cure light'
 
Cure light is a light powered spell that many spell
casters will use that are low on mana. When casted,
this spell will heal very light wounds of the caster
helping him avoid any further injury.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure poison' <target>
        c 'cure poison'
 
Poison is a unavoidable happening in the circle of life.
Whether some like it or not they will become poisoned. 
Spell casters will only turn to this spell to aid and 
cure it, cure poison. When casted, an aura will surround
the caster's body, thus nullifying any poisons in their
body.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'cure serious' <target>
        c 'cure serious'
 
Cure serious is an ancient spell that when casted,
it will fill the caster with good spirits, curing
serious injuries they have sustained in battle.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'curse' <target>
 
Curse is a very powerful spell many combat mages will
use during battle to lower the armor class of an 
opponent they are about to fight or fighting, thus 
making it easier for the caster to hit them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'death grip'
 
Death grip is a useful spell when casted, it
will make the spell caster's hands tighten as 
if they are dead. When death grip has been 
casted, the person cannot be disarmed.
 
Note: Death grip will only last and stay in 
affect for the duration of the spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'deathbarbs' <target>
        c 'deathbarbs'
 
Deathbarbs is a powerful skill in where a gifted spell
caster will open his hand after channeling energy, thus
shooting a fury of razor sharp barbs at an opponent 
making them sustain heavy damage.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: trance
 
In combat, a Monk has the ability to block out all distraction and
regain lost mana. The lower the amount of mana the monk has, the more
he will regain. This skill can only be used in combat and the monk
cannot perform any other duty while he is meditating.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'demonfire' <target>
 
Demonfire is a extremely wicked spell that has been 
around for centuries. Many spell casters use this 
before or during battle for the great damage it can 
bring. Also, on occasion the spell will also curse 
their opponent, damaging them and dropping their 
armor at the same time thus giving the spell caster
the advantage.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'destruction' <object>
 
This spell allows the Archmage to summon extremely powerful magicks to
convert an object entirely into energy and banish the energy into another plane.
Due to the complex incantations, most magicians only use it to destroy items
which they cannot otherwise get rid of.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect evil'
 
Detect evil is a crafty spell, in which when casted
will heighten the spell caster's awareness, allowing
them to detect evil in anyone that he walks by.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect good'
 
Detect good is a spell in which when casted will
heighten the spell caster's awareness, letting 
them detect good in anyone they walk by or that
passes them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect hidden'
 
Detect hidden is a powerful ally for any spell 
caster, for it's ability to heighten ones 
awareness, allowing them to detect people hiding
or sneaking around in their nearby area. This 
works for thieves especially, which any spell 
caster finds quite useful.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect invis'
 
Detect invis is the most frequently used spell of any
spell on the face of the planet. Every spell caster 
will rely on this, for it's ability to heighten their
abilities so that they may see anyone that is invisible
in their nearby location.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect magic'
 
Detect magic is a very unique spell that when casted, it 
will alert ones senses, allowing them to detect magic of 
any kind around them and in items they are wearing, 
wielding, and carrying.

helps.creator: none
none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'detect poison' <object>
 
Spell casters all over the world use this spell quite frequently.
When casted upon an object, it will alert the caster and let him
or her know if an object is poisoned. Many casters will do this 
before they let their king touch anything, to be on the safe side.

helps.creator: none
helps.text: Discharge removes one random stat from a piece of equipment.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'dispel evil' <target>
 
Dispel evil is a power spell that allows it's caster
to dispel the evil in a evil npc/character, thus 
greatly damaging them as the caster sucks the evil
from them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'dispel good' <target>
 
Dispel good is a powerful spell that allows a caster
to dispel the good from one of the pious, thus 
sucking from them the good they are blessed with,
greatly damaging them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'dispel magic' <target>
        c 'dispel magic'
 
Dispel magic is a extremely powerful spell that when
casted, it will strip the effects off of an opponent
thus making it easier for the spell caster to do 
more damage to them.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'dispel room'

The dispel room is the counterpart to the various room-affecting spells
such as room shield or momentary darkness.  When cast, it summons elemental
forces in the air that dispel such magics in the caster's room and also in
the surrounding rooms (unless there are closed doors in a direction).

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'eagle eye'
 
Eagle eye is a powerful Archmage skill that when 
casted, will allow an Archmage to see a large 
view of the area they are currently in. This will
only work when outdoors and will give you a bird's
eye view of the surrounding area.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'earthquake' <target>
 
Many rely on this powerful spell for it's ability to
control the fault lines, thus letting them manipulate
them to release a powerful earthquake at a whim, 
damaging anyone caught in it's path. Though, when this
spell is used, all mobs hit by it will attack the spell
caster, so it's used with caution.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
This command is used to show all the spells affecting your character. At
low levels, only the spell name will be displayed, at higher levels the
effects and duration of the spell will also be shown.  Spell effects
are no longer shown on score (this can be changed by using 'show' command).

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'electrical barrier'
 
Electrical barrier is a Geomancer's powerful ability to
control the very nature of electricity. When casted, it
will form a protective layer of electricity around the
caster, and during combat electricity will bounce from
the shield surrounding the caster and strike their 
opponent, making them sustain damage.
 
See also: FIRE BARRIER (and) FROST BARRIER

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'energy drain' <victim>
 
Energy drain is a necromantic spell which drains hit points from
the victim and gives them to the caster.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The energy field spell reduces damage from lightning or energy type
attacks by 25%.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'ensnare' victim
 
Ensnare is a Geomancer spell which taps the power of the earth
to raise vines which ensnare your opponent, preventing him
from fleeing.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast entrap <item in inventory>
 
The entrap spell allows a wizard to place a magical trap on an item,
scorching the fingers of anyone who attempts to pick it up. The damage
done is calculated from your level.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'faerie fire' <target>
        c 'faerie fire'
 
Faerie fire is a very powerful spell when casted,
it will lower the armor class of an opponent, thus
allowing a mage to hit them for more damage. This
spell will quickly turn any situation around to 
benefit the spell caster.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'faerie fog'
 
Faerie fog is a good spell when caster it will make  
everyone in the current room that is hiding, invis, 
and/or sneaking appear, being revealed by the caster.
Many use this as a self defense tactic so that they 
may see and attack an opponent.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fatigue' <target>
        c 'fatigue'
 
Fatigue is a powerful spell that when casted, it 
will greatly fatigue an opponent, dropping their
moves significantly. This becomes greatly effective
for the opponent that likes to run away, for when
fatigued they will not get very far.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fire barrier'
 
Fire barrier is a Geomancer's powerful ability to
control the ability of fire. When casted, it will
form a protective shielding around the caster, 
and during combat bolts of fire will strike their
opponent, making them sustain damage.
 
See also: FROST BARRIER (and) ELECTRICAL BARRIER

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fire cloud' <target>
 
A extremely powerful spell of the Archmage, this
spell has been known to disembowel rooms full of
people in it's time. When casted, this will 
consume the rooms around the caster in flames, 
thus damaging their oppoenents as the fires leap
at them. This spell is very damaging and used 
widely by the feared Archmages.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fireball'
 
Fireball is a medium powered mage spell when casted,
the caster will conjure a large fireball in the palm
of his hand, releasing it upon an opponent roasting 
them alive with thick hot fire.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fireproof' <target>
 
Fireproof is a spell caster defense tactic where one
will cast it on all of his equipment, or certain 
items, to stop them from being damaged due to fire
attacks from their opponents.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'fly' <target>
        c 'fly'
 
Fly is a frequently used spell where when it's
cast, the caster's feet will rise from the 
ground, thus halving the moves normally used 
when traveling from one location to another.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'frenzy'
 
Frenzy is a brutal spell where it will give the
caster a brutal look in their eyes, as death
and destruction becomes all they think about.
This spell will slightly lower ones armor, but
in return it will give you extra hitroll and 
damage roll for the duration of the spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'frost barrier'
 
Frost barrier is the Geomancer's powerful ability
to control the very nature of cold. When casted,
it will form a protective layer of frost around 
the caster, and during combat clumps of frost will
surge from the shield surrounding the caster and
strike their opponent, making them sustain damage.
 
See also: FIRE BARRIER (and) ELECTRICAL BARRIER

helps.creator: none
helps.text: Update me when you have time :)

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'giant strength'
 
Giant strength is a crowd favorite for the underdogs. 
When casted, it will give the caster supreme strength,
allowing them to do more damage and carry more items.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'glorious bolt' <target>
 
Glorious bolt is a extremely power spell that allows one to
call fourth a fury of glorious energy to blast into their
opponents, vaporizing their sorry lives. This spell is used
quite frequently by the powerful mage, and helps one greatly.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'harm' <target>
        c 'harm'
 
Harm, when casted will do significant amounts
of damage to an opponent, thus injuring him 
greatly. Many mages favor this spell for an 
attack by spell above all others, because of 
it's shear force while in combat.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'haste' <target>
        c 'haste'
 
Haste is a very unique spell everyone depends on. When
casted, this spell will speed up the caster's movements,
giving them an extra attack quite frequently during 
combat. Many see this spell as a way of life, and the 
young are taught this spell right after birth so that
they use it and hone their skills with it.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'heal' <target>
        c 'heal'
 
Heal is the most commonly used spell in the world. When
casted, it will replenish the report of the caster. No
adventurer will go through travels without this spell,
and most rely on this spell to save them from injury.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'heal' <target>
        c 'heal'

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Healing services are available at most temples. Type "heal" for a
list of what the healer offers. The priests of these temples are
usually corrupt, greedy individuals, so it will usually cost you
quite a penny to get patched up.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x cast 'healing aura' <target>
 
The healing aura spell accelerates the health regeneration rate
of the target.

helps.creator: Azrael
helps.text:
Syntax: hands target
 
With the faith of the cleric, he may call upon his god to heal 
the injured. This will cause the person to be healed of most 
things such as blindness, plagues, and poisons.
 
Also see: CURE BLINDNESS, CURE DISEASE, CURE POISON

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'holy shield' <shield name>
 
Holy shield is a extremely powerful ally for the Crusader.
When casted upon a shield, it will add bonuses to their AC
to help them during combat. Also,  it will give the 
Crusader more chance at turning around a draconians breath
attacks. This even works against pojectile weapons and 
spells (such as web, dispel magic, etc).

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'holy sword' <weapon name>
 
Holy sword is a extremely powerful ally for the Crusader.
When casted, it will add damage roll and hitroll to their
weapon, thus giving them more attacks and swifter ones. 
Also, whenever a Crusader does battle against a race 
with a vulnerability, the enchanted sword will hit them
with that vulnerability during the fight, thus doing
more damage for the Crusader.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'holy word' 
 
Holy word is a extremely powerful spell that allows one
to fill themselves with aiding spells, thus aiding them
in battle. When casted, it will give the caster a 
temporary frenzy and bless aid.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'ice storm' <target>
 
Ice storm is a powerful spell where one gifted in this
may call down a chaotic blizzard, to brutalize their
opponents. The more skilled one is in this, the better
chance they have at casting the spell more frequently
and for more damage.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'identify' <object>
 
When casted, intify will tell the spell caster all
the information possible on the object they are 
casting it upon, letting them know what it does.
 
Note: This spell may only be casted upon objects
currently in your infentory.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'improved invisibility' 
 
Improved invisibility is the spell caster's ability
to shield their presence, thus making them appear
invisible. Many thiefs will use this to loot, while
others will use this to hide. This is a widely used
and trusted spell.
 
Note: to see those that are invisible, you need to
either cast detect invisible, or where an item that
gives the affect.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'inferno'
 
The inferno spell raises a towering ring of flames within
the area, scorching all who exit or enter the room.
Players are only affected if they can be PKed by the caster
in the room in which the spell has been cast.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'infravision'
 
Infravision when cast, will heighten the abilities
of the spell caster, allowing them to see movement
in dark areas, thus heightening their vision and
whereabouts.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: infuse <object> <affect>
 
Infuse is the ranger's unique ability to enchant a weapon with a
magical affect.
 
Available affects: fire frost vampiric sharp vorpal shocking

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: inventory
		equipment

INVENTORY shows you the items you are currently carrying with you.
EQUIPMENT shows you all of the equipment you are currently wearing.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'invisibility' <target>
        c 'invisibility'
 
When casted, invisibility will shroud it's caster from
the world of the living, making them invisible to all
around them. When casted, the only way one that's 
invisible may be seen is by someone who is wearing an
item with detect invisible or one that has casted the
spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'kill' <target>
        c 'kill'
 
Kill is a very dark necromatic spell in which a 
skilled necromancer calls upon the dark gods
to stop the flow of life energy within their opponent, thus
killing him instantly. This is a widely used spell
by all necromancers, especially ones who do not wish
to engage in a full-scale battle.
 
Several defenses have been developed to counter the kill
spell by wizards of the light. They are sanctuary and light
shroud; the holy energy of these spells blocks the dark
necromantic magic, rendering it useless.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'lightning bolt' <target>
        c 'lightning bolt'
 
Lightning bolt is a very useful attack spell where the
caster will raise his hand, channeling energy and then,
a lightning bolt will shoot from it striking the 
opponent, in turn damaging them.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'locate object' <object name>
 
Locate object lets you sense items within the world from afar.
It is not guaranteed to work and will only tell you the name of the
character carrying the object or the room it is in (not how to get
to it).

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'magic missle' <target>
        c 'magic missle'
 
Magic missle, when casted the spell caster will
channel his own energies, creating a small missle
to shoot at his opponent. This spell is very 
effective, but not widely used because of the 
spell's low damage rate.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Mana is the magical power that flows through all living
things. It can be called upon for extraordinary powers,
although only sentient beings can truly master its use.
Mana regenerates with time just as health, but since the
mind is only as strong as the body, hunger, thirst
and ailments will slow it down.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'mass healing'
 
Mass healing is a very powerful spell in where a 
spell caster will cast it, and in turn he/she will
heal all in the room with him/her. This is also 
dangerous, for it will also heal any mobiles in 
the room with you.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'mass invis'
 
Mass invis is a powerful spell in where a spell 
caster will cast this, and thus will make everything
in the room with him/her become invisible for the
duration of the spell.
 
Note: This spell will also make any mobiles in the 
room with you invis as well.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'maze'
{X        c 'maze' 'target'

The maze spell can be used for both offense and utility, allowing an
archmage to teleport their target to either {aGeldoff's Maze{X or the {aPyramid of{X
{athe Abyss{X. When cast in combat, the spell will transport either the caster
or their target to {aGeldoff's Maze{X for {Y3 ticks{X, before depositing

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
This cleric skill allows said clerics to regain lost mana faster 
by using various concentration techniques (relaxation, visualization,
mantras, burning incense, inhaling the smoke of certain grasses, etc.)

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'momentary darkness'
 
Momentary darkness is a powerful Illusionist skill. It shrouds the
entire room in a magical black fog so thick that none except a god
can see through it. It stops all combat, but requires a reagent to
cast.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Some especially powerful magical spells, such as the gate and
nexus spells, require a special rock called a moonstone to channel
the power of the moon and form a portal. These rocks are not easily
stumbled upon, although they do warp around randomly due to their
strange properties and may be discovered. It is also rumored that
the creatures of the outskirts of the Netherworld possess these strange
stones, but those territories are chaotic and extremely dangerous.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: play <song>
        play <song> <target>
 
Music is a very powerful bard skill in where one
will play songs on their insturments, altering
the very fabric of all that is around them. Some 
use their gift for song and dance, while others
use it to their deepest and darkest desires.
 
Song Title                       Level         Mana
----------------------------------------------------
Purple Mist                        1            75
Fireworks                          2            50
A Dwarven Tale                     3            75
Fade to Black                      5            75
Pretty in Pink                     7            75
Aquatic Polka                      8            75
Another Gate                       9            50
Awareness Jig                      11            100
Swamp Song                         13            65
Fat Owl Hopping                    14            70
Stormy Weather                     15            50
Rigor                              18            125
Firefly Tune                       20            50
Blessed Be                         22            75
Dark Cloud                         25            75
Curse of the Abyss                 28            100
 
Note: To play songs, you must enclose the song in
      quotes.
 
Example:  play 'awareness jig' 
          play 'curse of the abyss' knight
 
 
See also: help <song name>

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'nexus' <player name>
 
Nexus is a useful spell when casted, it will make
a gate appear before the caster, thus connecting 
them to the person they casted it upon. The more
knowledged one is in nexus, the longer the gate
will stay up. 
 
Note: This spell cannot be casted upon mobiles, 
and the gate will stay in the room where it was
first casted

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'pass door'
 
When casted, pass door allows the caster to 
travel through closed doors, allowing them
in locations they might not normally be able
to get into. Keep in mind pass door will not
get you into everything and everywhere.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'plague' <target>
        c 'plague'
 
Plague alone has been known to cause worldwide disease 
and sickness. It has toppled villages and even kingdoms.
When casted, plague will engulf the opponent with many 
plagues and diseases, thus stopping their regeneration
completely. Be warned, when your opponent is infected 
with this spell, you may in turn receive it from them 
during combat, for it's ability to widely spread.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'poison' <target>
        c 'poison'
 
Poison is a deadly spell and used widely by many
spell casters. When casted, it will consume their
opponent in poisons, and over time it will sap 
their opponents report, slowly killing them. The
more the caster is trained in this, the longer 
the spell will last for. 
 
See also: CURE POISON

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'raise dead' <corpse>
 
Raise dead is an extremely powerful Necromantic spell
which can resurrect a mobile or a player. It will only
work if the corpse retains its head, and highly
drains the health and magical energies of the caster.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'recharge' <object>
 
Recharge is the powerful Alchemist spell which allows
them to recharge any depleted wands, staves, orbs, and
other magical items back to full strength.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: recite <scroll> <target>
		quaff <potion>
		zap <target>
		brandish <staff>

RECITE will recite a scroll in your inventory, onto a target
if applicable. With a scroll of heal, 'recite scroll axel' would
cast a heal spell on Axel.

QUAFF will quaff a magial potion. 'quaff potion'. nuff said.

ZAP will zap somebody with a wand, assuming you are holding a wand
in your hand. 'zap ravage' with a wand of lightning he might get 
very pissed off.

BRANDISH will invoke the magical powers of a staff you are holding.

helps.creator: Azrael
helps.text:
Syntax: reverie mind <amount>
Syntax: reverie body <amount>

Mind over matter.  One may use the strength of their body, and transfer
it for the use of magical energy or vice versa.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'room shield'
 
Room shield is a powerful Wizard spell which channels
the caster's mana to create a shield of energy within the room.
The shield pushes outward at the room's edges, preventing
entry into the room by normal means. Due to its nature,
entry into the room will only be blocked if the player attempting
it can be PKed within the room. Additionally, the spell may only
be cast indoors.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'sanctuary' <target>
        c 'sanctuary'
 
Sanctuary is probably one of the most used spells to date.
When casted, it will halve the damage the caster will 
take during combat, or by use of spells. Many marvel at 
it's ability to stop the necromancer's kill spell from 
taking affect.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'shield' <target>
        c 'shield'
 
Shield has been around forever, and is still widely used 
by many spell casters. When casted, it will form a force
field around the spell caster, shielding them from harm.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'silence' <target>
 
Silence is possibly one of the most powerful tools of the
Sorcerer. Evoking astral energies, they can prevent the victim
from casting spells or even speaking. Due to its incredible
power, a reagent is needed.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'sleep' <target>
 
Sleep is a extremely powerful spell that when casted, it will
render an opponent unconcious. This can lead to more devestating
things. Such as your opponent being able to dispel your magic,
or more vile things such as having kill spell cast. It's better to
avoid this spell if you're on the receiving end of this at all
costs.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'slow' <target>
 
The slow spell slows down the actions of the victim, reducing the amount
of attacks they get per round as well as the speed of their movement.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'spell deflection' <target>
        c 'spell deflection'
 
Spell deflection is a very powerful spell many skilled
casters rely on still today. When casted, it will 
provide a barrier that fuses around the casted. In 
combat this spell has the chance at instantly shooting
spells casted at the caster back to his/her opponent.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'spell shield' <target>
        c 'spell shield'
 
Spell shield when casted will provide a good aura
of energy that will form around the caster, thus
raising his defenses to spells dramatically, 
providing him with supreme protection.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast starflare

The Starflare spell draws astral powers from the cosmic realm and brings
them down on every opponent in the room.  Effects of this light include
damage and a temporary blindness.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'stone skin' <target>
        c 'stone skin'
 
Stone skin is a powerful cleric spell that allows one
to fuse a barrier all over their body, making it rock
solid, thus preventing the amount of damage one will
receive in combat. It has prooven time and time again
to be extremely useful for a fighter.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'stone spikes'
 
Summoning elemental magic from the earth, the Geomancer can use this spell to
raise a series of stone spikes in the surrounding rooms. These spikes do damage to anyone
unlucky enough to be standing near them as cancelling their sneaking and hiding
affects.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'summon' <player>
 
Sorcerers all around the world use this powerful spell. When 
casted, a sorcerer will have the ability to summon another 
directly to their location. To do this, the player that is 
being summoned must turn their 'no summon' off, so that they
can be summoned. 
 
In order to summon anyone 20 levels or more below you who isn't
PK, you must be at least 7 rooms away from a PK area.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: cast 'third eye' <player name>
 
The third eye spell allows a Warlock to momentarily see
through the eyes of a victim. The spell will only work if the
caster has the victim's skull in his posession.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'underwater breathing'
 
Underwater breathing is a useful spell, and when
casted, gills will appear behind the ears of the
caster, allowing them to freely breath as a fish
woul in water. They will not take damage as usual
from drowning, allowing them to freely explore 
the seas.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'vision'
 
Vision is a powerful ally to the traveling 
Ranger. When one is in the wilds and is unsure
about which way to go, they will cast this spell
in which will give them a bird's eye view of the
surrounding area.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'weaken' <target>
        c 'weaken'
 
Weaken is a powerful spell that when casted, it will
make the opponent weak and weary, thus dropping their
strength significantly. When casted, it will make an
opponent not hit with as much force as before. Which
has been known to save the caster's life more then once.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'web' <target>
        c 'web'
 
When casted, web will cover the spell caster's 
opponent in thick webs, thus halting their 
movement, and making it very stricted. Many 
will use this to take an upper hand in combat, 
and others rely on it's effectiveness.
 
Note: If you are engulfed by web, you will not
be able to flee for the duration of the spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: c 'word of recall'
 
Transports you to the recall location of the area you are in.

helps.creator: Azrael
helps.text:
Syntax: bar <direction>

The bar skill allows a Highwayman to brace a door with a block of wood or
whatever else is available.  A door that is barred can only be unsealed
again with the BASH command, from either direction.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The detect trap skill allows a Rogue to detect any dangerous exits
(deathtraps) from a room upon entering it, and also to recognize any
magically entrapped items just by looking at them.  It is used automatically
when practiced and does not need to be invoked.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: exits

Shows you all of the visible exits to a room.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: fade <direction>
 
Allows a remorted player to fade out of the world and thus move
several rooms at a time.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: feign
 
This is a skill where one lies on the ground, giving
their best impression of a corpse. When done right,
you will appear dead to others nearby, hopefully 
giving you that chance to be undetected.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: follow <person>
 
Allows you to follow a player as he walks around. This 
command does not place you in the group of the player
automatically; for that, he/she must GROUP you. Also note
that follow will not automatically pursue another player
who is running away from you.
 
see also: GROUP NOFOLLOW AUTOASSIST PURSUIT

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: gohome

Recall you to your home, if you own one. Costs all of your
movement points.

See also: HOME

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: group <person>
        group
 
Puts a person who is following you into your formation.
'Group' without an argument shows you the level and vital
statistics of your formation members.
 
see also: FT SPLIT

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: hunt <target>
{x        hunt <target> auto
 
Hunt is the assassin's ability to seek out and
hunt their target, tracking them down based on
their scent. They will raise their head and 
flick their tongue in the air, trying to locate
how close they are to a certain target. The more
knowledged an assassin is in this, the easier one
will be able to sense their target in the nearby 
area.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: mount <name>
		dismount <name>

Mounts or dismounts a steed.

helps.keyword: NORTH EAST SOUTH WEST UP DOWN NORTHWEST NORTHEAST SOUTHEAST SOUTHWEST
helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: <direction>

Move in a particular direction.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: recall
 
The recall command petitions the gods to take you
to the closest place of sanction. This command may
only be used by those level 30 and below. Higher
levels must use the 'word of recall' spell.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: scan
		scan <direction>

The scan command surveys all directions and shows
what PCs and NPCs are in those rooms. You can scan
in a particular direction, i.e. 'scan south', to
see what is in that direction only.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
You can search a room by typing search. This will search the room for anything
that may be hidden, mainly exits.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The fine vessel 'Endeavor' regularly makes its rounds around Seralia
and Athemia.  Times and locations are as follows: 
 
Olaria - 1:00 AM
Plith - 7:00 AM
Achaeus - 4:00 PM
 
{RNote:{x the boat shows as a {y@{x on the wilderness map.
{x {x {x {x {X {X {XIt will arrive at the pier.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: sleep <location>
		wake
		rest <location>
		stand

Sleep, wake, rest, and stand all change your position
within the game. While sleeping, you regain mana and health
much faster but are much more susceptible to attack. While
resting, you regenerate faster but can watch for incoming
attacks. You can sleep and rest on objects (i.e. 'sleep bed').

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: sneak
		hide

Sneak allows you to move around silently, so messages such
as 'Chester has arrived' will not be seen by players if you
are sneaking. It is a skill used by thieves and marauders
to get close to their prey before disemboweling them.

Hide is a technique of hiding in the shadows from everybody
in the room, but only as long as you do not move.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Trackless step is a skill unique to the Ranger. When travelling in nature, they
can keenly cover their tracks, making it almost impossible for them to be hunted.
This skill is automatic and applies in field, forest, hill, mountain, and 
tundra areas.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: auction <item>
		auction help
		auction bid <amount>

Auction is the built-in system on Sentience that allows
you to sell items. 'auc help' shows you some information
about the item currently being auctioned. 'auc <item>'
auctions one of the items currently in your inventory.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: brew 'spell name'
 
Brew creates a magical potion which casts a spell when quaffed.
To create a potion, you must have an empty vial.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: combine <item1> <item2>
 
Using this command, an alchemist can combine two magical
scrolls or two magical potions together. Note that
the items cannot have a total of more than four spells.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Most items in Sentience decay over time due to damage from
use, enemy magical spells, and breath weapons. They are rated
as strong (decays slowly), normal (decays at a gradual rate)
and weak (decays quickly), or solid (does not decay).

All items can be repaired at the blacksmith, but only a
certain amount of times. If you do not repair your armor
it can crumble into dust eventually from use, and once
weapons get worn away enough from use they will break.

An item can also be fragged (depending on its material)
by damage from fire, frost, acid, or electricity weapons.
An item with the 'burnproof' flag will not frag. Most of
the time these attacks only damage equipment and cause
it to decay.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: drop <item>
{x        drop all.<keyword>
{x        drop all
{x        drop all.coins
{x        drop all.gold
{x        drop all.silver
{x        give <item> <person>
{x        give all.<keyword> person

DROP drops an item on the ground.

GIVE passes items ('give sword Felix'), or gold
and silver coinage ('give 200 silver Felix').
 
{RNOTE:{x For convenience and safety purposes, 
containers will not be dropped with "drop all"
and "drop all.<keyword>". They must be dropped individually.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: envenom <weapon>
 
Envenom is an ancient skill of the thieves, in where 
they will coat the blades of their weapons with many
poisons. After doing such, they will fight their 
opponents, poisoning them with their weapons.
The more skilled they are in this, the better chance
they have at poisoning their weapons.
 
see also: POISON

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: get <keyword>
		get <keyword> <container>
		put <keyword> <container>

GET and TAKE pick up an object on the ground. They also
retrieve objects from containers ('get bottle bag', 'get sword chest').
PUT puts an object into a container ('put steak box').

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: gold

The economy of Sentience is based on gold and silver
coins. The standard exchange rate is 100 silver coins
per one gold crown. Gold coins are also 4 times as heavy
as silver coins to carry (25 gold coins to the pound,
as opposed to 100 for the silver).

The GOLD command will show you the amount of silver
and gold coins you are carrying in your inventory.

helps.creator: Emma
helps.text:
{XSyntax: keep <object>
 
The keep skill allows you to prevent yourself from accidentally
dropping an item when using the "drop all" command as well as giving
the item away. Items marked for keeping will show a {b({BK{b) {Xnext
to them in your inventory.
 
{RWARNING: {XThis command will NOT prevent your items from being
CPKed, fragged or stolen.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: unlock <direction>
        unlock <container>
 
UNLOCK is a command that allows one to unlock a container
or chest, assuming you have in your possession the right
key.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax:
{x locker rent
{x locker put <item name>
{x locker get <item name>
{x locker list

A locker is a storage facility which allows you to keep up to 30 items
in storage, even if you can't save them.

RENT - Rents a locker for one month (5000 gold)

PUT <item name> - stores an item in your locker, if room is
available.

GET <item name> - removes an item from your locker.

LIST - lists the items in your locker.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Lore is a general skill, consisting of knowledge of myths and legends. 
Use of the lore skill gives a chance of obtaining information on an object,
concerning its power and uses. It is automatic and invoked whenever an item
is looked at.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The mail system in Sentience is operated by the same goblins who own
Goblin Airship, Inc. and Transcontinental Submarine Sealines. They will
send a package for you at a price depending on the weight its contents,
and attach a parchment with it for free.
 
The commands are pretty straightforward (you can be at any post office). 
 
{Ymail to <person>  {x(start a mail package)
{Ymail show         {x(show what is currently in the package)
{Ymail put <object> {x(add an object to the package)
{Ymail get <object> {x(remove an object from the package)
{Ymail write        {x(write a message)
{Ymail cancel       {x(cancel the mail)
{Ymail send         {x(pay postage and send the package)
{Ymail check        {x(check your mail)
{Ymail info         {x(see the status of mail you've sent/received)
 
Picked up packages drop off the "mail info" list after a bit of 
time has expired. Also if an while (a few real-life weeks) passes 
before a package is picked up, it is returned back to its sender.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: open <direction>
		open <container>
		close <direction>
		close <container>

The open and close commands open and close doors and containers.
Example: 'open north', 'open bag', 'open door'

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Allows a thief to get a peek at someone else's 
inventory when looked at, letting them see 
everything that you're carrying at the time.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: pick <direction>
        pick <container>
 
Picks the lock on a door/container. The success of this
depends on your lockpicking skill and the strength of a
lock. Some locks will only open to keys and can't be 
picked.
 
Example: 'pick north' (or) 'pick gate' (or) 'pick chest'

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: repair <item>

If you are at a blacksmith you can repair your damaged or
broken equipment, assuming it can be repaired. Every piece
of equipment can only tolerate so many magical repairs before
it is rendered useless and falls apart.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: restring item short 'new name'
{x        restring item desc (description editor)

Restring permanently renames one of your objects. Restringing
is provided by specialists like Warren the Gnoll in Plith, and does
cost quite a bit of money. 

The short and long descriptions of an object can be altered with
this command. The short description is what you see when you handle
the object ('a longsword, a steel mace'), and the long description
is what you see when the object is lying on the ground ('A steel mace
is lying here').

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: sacrifice <item>
{x        sacrifice all.<item>
{x        sacrifice all

Sacrifices an item or amount of money to the gods
in return for deity points to be used on heavenly favours.

Also see: 'deity points'

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
Syntax: scribe 'spell 1' 'spell 2' 'spell 3'
 
Scribe creates a scroll with up to three spells. You must have a blank
scroll in order to scribe something. Due to magical limitations on the paper
which the scrolls are created from, certain spells such as the necromantic
kill spell cannot be scribed. Also, only a combination of spells which does
not exceed 200 mana altogether can be scribed.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: recite scroll <target>
        recite scroll
 
Scrolls is the skill in which one may have use of a 
magic-user's ability to wield and control magical
spells temporarily. The more knowledged one is in
this, is the chance that they will land whatever
scroll they are trying to use.

helps.keyword: SHOPS LIST BUY SELL INSPECT VALUE
helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: list <shopkeeper>
		buy <shopkeeper> <item>
		sell <shopkeeper> <item>
		inspect <shopkeeper> <item>
		value <shopkeeper> <item>

LIST lists all the items currently for sale in the shop.
BUY purchases an item from the shopkeeper.
SELL sells one of your items to the shopkeeper, assuming he is
interested in what you have to sell.
INSPECT shows you some information about one of the items up for sale.
VALUE will show the item to the shopkeeper and he will appraise it.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: split <silver> <gold>
 
Splits a certain amount of silver and/or gold among 
the members in your formation.
 
Example: split 20 50 = split 20 silver, 50 gold

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: brandish <target>
 
Staves is a skill, where one may use staves
to do their bidding. The more knowledged one
is in this skill, is how well they may use 
staves and the affect that they will do to
whom they choose.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Theft is the defining skill of the thief, and is only available to that class.
It allows items to be stolen from the inventory of monsters and players,
and even from shops! Some thieves are so skillful they can steal the shirt
right off your back or the shoes off your feet.

helps.creator: Azrael
helps.text:
Syntax: throw <weapon> <target>

With practice, one may learn the ability to throw almost anything. 
However, weapons are the best choice because they may actually hurt an
opponent.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Syntax: wear <item>
		wield <item>
		hold <item>

All three of these will allow you to equip an item onto yourself.
'wear shield', 'wield sword', 'hold flag' will all do the same thing.

categories.name: professions
categories.description: General info about professions and subclasses; this doesn't include their skills or spells.
categories.creator: Syn

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
{YPrerequisites:{x Witch or Monk
{x
Adepts are masters in the skill of fighting evil.  They are often
recruited for exorcism duties as well as full-scale wars on the servants of
darkness.  Undead creatures tremble at the mention of an Adept, as the
exquisite pain these holy clerics can inflict can be matched by none other
than a god.  
{x 
{YFighting style:{x One-handed, usually a sword or mace
{YSkills:{x
{x  turn undead
{YSpells:{x
{x  avatar shield, exorcism, glorious bolt, light shroud
{YSpecial abilities:{x
{x  None

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
{YPrerequisites:{x Witch or Druid
{x
The alchemist is otherwise known as the master of magic materials.  They
can craft fiendish explosives, brew powerful potions and scribe scrolls

then brute force or offensive magic. They wield as much power as mages;
however, the nature of this power comes from their unique ability to
channel the power of the gods. This ability comes from their indomitable
spirit, daily meditation, and self-sacrifice to achieve a greater state of
being. Indeed, Clerics are perhaps the most disciplined of all ways of life,

city governments to take on quests of incredible magnitude.  They have an
apt taste for questing and roaming the lands, often preferring the company

force and sheer power.  They are far more feared on the battlefield than any
other warrior, and the sound of their powerful battle cries is enough to

its powers. Druids are generally more comfortable in the serenity of
a forest rather than a dungeon but they can call on their magic
anywhere.  They regenerate their power much faster in areas they

the energy to their will.  They are well versed in the use of earth, wind,

being the best warriors alive with any weapon. Although they don't
have the ferocity of marauders or the devotion and magical powers of

best at what they do.  They live on the road, stealing from both the good

making the unreal seem real.  They are no mere tricksters, however, as they
can make the night turn to day and vice versa, often using their powerful
spells to their personal gain.  The most powerful illusionists of the past
have been known to make castles disappear and turn dragons to stone, only to
take off and never be seen again.

Mages lead a life devoted to the inner flow of energy within all
living things, called mana by most. The vast majority of their powers
come from tapping the core of energy within themselves; a mage's
true skill comes not from the rote memorization and reciting of
spells, but instead from his or her ability to reach this energy.
Mages deal with all areas of offensive magic, as they emerged from
a warrior class who realized that only brute force would not conquer
an enemy with supernatural powers. However, mages alone are quite
poor at fighting hand-to-hand; they generally wield daggers in a single
hand for defense from petty opponents, and reserve their magic for
use against the truly powerful enemies.

much as the glory of battle. They often fight with no regard for
their own well-being and are feared on every battlefield. A charge by

The Ninja are a class of thieves whose life is dedicated to stealth and
deadliness.  They train from sunrise to sunset and are the most fierce,
crafty fighters in existence, ready to kill as many opponents as possible if
cornered.  However, it is rarely necesarry for the Ninja can choose to only
be seen when wanted, and can sneak into a heavily guarded castle without 
waking so much as a rat.
