The paladin is a holy crusader whose powers are closely tied to those
of the gods. Due to this they are the only warriors who can perform
small amounts of magic, mainly healing and curative spells. Paladins
are more proficient at using long-range weapons and fighting with a
shield; they are very efficient, organized fighters, depending on
both their strength and the strength of their god to give them
victory in battle. They are also extremely intelligent, playing games
of strategy and reading books of famous conquests and defeats from
the first day of their training.

company of nature.  They often make a living in the wilderness as guides,
knowing the ins and outs of deep forests as if they were the streets of
their hometowns.  They have a particularly sharp knack for locating exactly

never get lost.

they are not the most moral of characters. They prefer to use their
cunning and tend to avoid killing somebody unless necesarry; they are
not entirely objected to the latter, either. They are very skilled
at pilfering and work under cover of night and silence.

The Sages of Sentience are some of the wisest thieves in existence, not
only knowing every trick in the book but knowing how to evade them.  They
have extensive knowledge of creatures as well as an uncanny perception of
character, being able to tell someone's true intentions simply by looking at
them.  They have risen above the level of petty thievery and are commonly
employed as high advisors in royal courts as they know more about thief
tactics than anyone else alive.

living beings. They can, with difficulty, influence other people
through their flow of mana, and can even channel another being's mana
into themselves, revitalizing their magical abilities. Sorcerers,
unlike wizards, have never identified themselves with either side of

Thieves are masters of deftness and cunning above all other classes.
They base their skills on the ability to avoid a fight of brute force
because they will almost certainly lose. Instead, thieves lurk and 
hide in the shadows, light of foot, treading the darkness; none can
surpass their range of unique skills or think faster in a pinch.

These dark shamans practice an ancient form of magic considered evil
and horrible by most. They use the skulls of their dead victims and
link the dark power of their gods to them, evoking horrid affects on

A Warlord is a master of leadership and cunning battle strategy, with the
smarts and skills to lay waste to an entire army.  They are few and far
between, often recruited for huge amounts of pay to defend small townes from
attack.  Warlord-led formations have routed huge armies while vastly
outnumbered, and they are known to well love the challenge of defeating an
enemy using tactics rather than brute strength.

a weapon. They are masters of discipline and self-control, and their tolerance for

their magic to preserve life, and to avoid rule, for they believe

upon their might and a boost of magical energy, they can release
a huge flow of adrenaline and enter an enraged state. This temporarily

race is known for to their advantage. If fighting hand-to-hand,

of the opponent. The damage done depends on the Lich's level.

aura to the mortal world and locate creatures of a certain

work, and it only works on NPCs which are visible to the Lich
and are in the mortal plane.

{x  rack <victim>

energies and move at lightning speed through the victim
and back, inflicting damage through supernatural energy.

squarish features and a slowed-down tone. Titans are
ancient, given birth to by the gods before the humans,

Titanic attack gives the Titan one more chance to 
swing in a round of combat. It is automatic and does not
need to be activated. A mastered titanic attack skill
does not guarantee an extra attack, and the slow spell
cuts its chance of success by half.

helps.creator: Syn
helps.text:
The holy wrath which flows through the bodies and
minds of the Slayer gives them a powerful advantage
when fighting evildoers. If successful, it increases
the damage done against evil-aligned opponents by 10%.
Holy wrath is automatic and does not need to be activated.

The shift skill allows Slayers in their normal humanoid formto 
uncage the beast within and turn into a terrifying, powerful 
creature of fangs and claws. Shifted slayers do not wear equipment
or weapons and get lots of hits in battle, depending on their
shift skill. A slayer can constrain the demon within and go back
to his/her normal humanoid form at any time. Both shifting to
the Slayer form and shifting back drains the user of energy.

The slayer is the ultimate of holy warriors; it is
a special sect that wishes to seek out the undead and
put an end to their measly existence. Years of training
under the parish and with clerical assistance the Slayer
develops a technique of damaging the undead beyond repair.
Slayers have for centuries despised vampires as the most

The stake skill has been perfected by the Slayer race
over the years as a trusty way to get rid of vampires. To
stake a vampire, you must be carrying a wooden stake in your
inventory, and your victim must be asleep. A successful stake

to gore as many opponents as possible in the least amount
of time. It allows a minotaur to charge wildly into the fray,
knocking down and hurting any opponent who isn't protected.
Due to its tremendous power, a charge expends lots of movement.

The mighty minotaur is a brute warrior with a human body but more
bovine features. His face resembles a man more than a bull, but he
has giant horns with which to gore opposition. Minotaurs have very
thick skin and grow thick coats of fur rather than hair like humans.
They are malicious but not the most intelligent of creatures.

{x  bite <victim> [toxin type]

The Sith are widely known for using their serpentine skills
to inflict a wide range of misery upon their prey. Their natural
toxins and poisons make catching food twice as easy and fighting
much more fun. The method of delivery for these venoms is their
pincer-sharp bite, which also inflicts physical damage. To use
a specific toxin on an enemy, use bite <victim> <toxin>. To
deliver a bite of venomous poison which causes effects similar
to that of the poison spell, just use bite <victim>.

Syntax:
{x  danger <number of rooms>

Sense danger is an automatic skill which allows a Sith
to spot PK and CPK rooms from a distance by feeling vibrations
in the ground and by tasting the air. The range at which
danger is reported can be set using the danger command, e.g.
"danger 5" will alert you if there is a PK or CPK room five or
less rooms away. The maximum range you can sense dangerous
areas depends on how good you are at the skill.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
{YAlignment: {RMalice{x
{x
The Sith are a race terrifying to behold. Just as the might of
dragon and human was combined by the Pious, the blend of serpentine
powers with human tactfulness gave birth to the Sith. They have tails
and serpent-like scales all over their bodies, as well as fangs and a
tongue so sensitive it allows them to track creatures by scent. Sith
are relentless and most have almost no sympathy for any sort of life,
instead seeking to poison and destroy it.
{x

Tail kick delivers a stunning blow to a victim

tail and striking hard in the abdominal region.

Toxins are the Sith's favorite tactic of attack. In addition
to their poisonous blood, Sith constantly regenerate dangerous
toxins to use on their enemies. To check your toxin supplies,
type "toxins". 
{x
There are four main types of toxins: paralysis, weakness,
neurotoxin, and venom. To use one, type bite <victim> <toxin name>.
Toxins take a short time to affect the victim, and there is a 
chance that strong enough victims will resist their influence.
{x
{YPARALYSIS{x
Syntax:
{x  bite <victim> paralyze
{x
This toxin paralyzes the victim for a short time if successful,
leaving him/her open to any attack the Sith can muster before
it wears off. 
{x
{YWEAKNESS{x
Syntax:
{x  bite <victim> weakness
{x
This toxin saps the victim's strength and movement if
successful, leaving them weak as a newborn kitten.
{x
{YNEUROTOXIN{x

{x  bite <victim> neurotoxin
{x
This toxin consists of powerful agents which sap the mental

{x

{x  bite <victim> venom
{x
This toxin causes the victim to fall into a deep slumber, leaving

fresh blood from living opponents. It also inflicts physical damage.
Dextrous opponents can dodge a vampire's bite, and its chance of
success also depends on the level difference between vampire and
victim. Sometimes, the unholy energies flowing through the vampire's
body cause the victim to go into a paroxysm for a short period of time;
in this state, they cannot control their movements and thrash about
wildly like a fish out of water.

helps.creator: Syn

habits of the vampire, allows them to regain health and sate

normal form at any time.

to their greatest enemy, the sun. The better you are at the
temperance skill, the more sun damage will be reduced. However,

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Churches are groups of people bound by religion, and driven by a common
goal. Neutral players may join any church, and good and evil players 
may not join a church of the opposite alignment.
{x
To register a church, you must have 3,000,000 deity points.
{x
The syntax is:
{x
{Y  church create 'church name' 'church insignia' good|neutral|evil{x
{x
The member commands are:
{x
{Y  church talk                   {x: sends messages to your church's members
{Y  church list <#>               {x: lists information about a particular church
{Y  church list                   {x: lists all current churches
{Y  church info                   {x: shows information about your church members
{Y  church where                  {x: find out where your church members are
{Y  church gohall                 {x: recall to the church hall, if your church has one
{Y  church motd                   {x: view church message of the day
{Y  church rules                  {x: view church rules
{Y  church deposit                {x: deposit pneuma, dp, or gold into the church
{Y  church balance                {x: show pneuma in the church account*
{Y  church quit                   {x: quits your church (you lose all pneuma and karma)
{Y  church withdraw               {x: withdraws pneuma, karma, or gold from church
{Y  church gohall                 {x: recalls to the church temple if you have one
{x
The following are leader-only commands:
{x
{Y  church addmember              {x: add a member{M*{x
{Y  church delmember              {x: remove a member{M*{x
{Y  church promote                {x: promote a member
{Y  church demote                 {x: demote a member
{Y  church motd edit              {x: edit the church motd
{Y  church rules edit             {x: edit the church rules
{Y  church setflag <string>       {x: set your church insignia (who flag){M*{x
{Y  church excommunicate          {x: excommunicates a church member{M*{x{M*{x
{Y  church toggle                 {x: toggle a church's PK status{M*{x{M*{x{M*{x
{Y  church transfer               {x: transfer pneuma, karma, or gold to other churches
{Y  church takeover               {x: take over the church and become its founder
{Y  church convert <good|evil>    {x: convert a neutral church to good or evil (see below)
{Y  church set <setting>          {x: toggles a setting for your church (see below)
{x
{M*{x Must be at a diviner (church office) to perform this function.
{M*{x{M*{x Excommunicate is a way for a leader to punish a member of his
church; an excommunicated player may only use the LIST, RULES, and
QUIT commands until he is deemed to re-enter his leader's good graces.  
{M*{x{M*{x{M*{x Once PK is toggled, it costs 5000 pneuma to turn it off.
{x
Church temples cost 25K pneuma as base cost. You can upgrade your
church temple as your church expands. All churches start out as Bands,
then may be upgraded to Cult, Order, and Church. Upgrading your
church allows you to enlist more members as well as giving higher
experience bonuses for good and evil churches.
{x 
{YUpgrade Costs:{x
To advance to the next level, a church must have the following:

{BBand->Cult{x 25000 pneuma, 4,000,000 dp, 500,000 gold 
{BCult->Order{x 75000 pneuma, 10,000,000 dp, 1,000,000 gold
{BOrder->Church{x 150,000 pneuma, 15,000,000 dp, 2,500,000 gold
{x
{YChurch Settings:{x
These can be set using the "church set" command.

{Yshow_pks          {x: toggles whether you and your members see pk stats in "church info"
{Yallow_crosszones  {x: toggles whether your members can recall cross-zone (leaders can always do it)
{x
ex. church set show_pks
{x
{YConverting:{x
A neutral church can convert to either good or evil. This costs 10,000 pneuma and 2,500,000 karma,
and it cannot be undone. All members who aren't of the proper alignment to follow the church's new
faith will be removed when they log in.
{x 
For information on church temples see "help temples".
 
{YChurch activity:{x
Churches are required to be active. The requirements to be considered active:

{M * {xFounder must have logged in within the last 3 months.
{M * {xAt least three different members must have logged in within the previous month.
 
Both of these must be violated several times to be disbanded on grounds of
inactivity.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Death is a rather shady, sarcastic character with a devilish
sense of humor which appeals to nobody. Since no adventurer
can possibly know what lies in every dark corner, death is nothing
but a fact of life. 

For every time your body perishes you are sentenced to 5 minutes 
in the Netherworld and the loss of most of your gold and silver. 
If you die in a CHAOTIC player killing room, your corpse will
remain in the room along with all your posessions to be looted by
whoever comes across it.

The five-minute wait may be bypassed if one strikes a deal with
Geldoff the Warlock in the Netherworld, but it does cost deity points.

helps.creator: none
helps.text:
Deity points are a measure of how much sway you have with the
gods. They are used for godly favors, and are necesarry for
churches to thrive. Deity points can be obtained in the following
ways:

		* sacrificing gold, equipment, etc. to the gods
		
They are used for the following:

		* an instant reincarnation after death
		* church leader commands, such as promote, demote,
				addmember, delmember, etc.
		* church temple purchase and upgrading

helps.creator: Elden
helps.text:
Pneuma represent the essense, or soul, of fallen foes and beings that
dwell in this realm.  Many of these souls can be found inside tightly bound
bottles deep within the Pyramid of the Abyss.  These bottled souls must be
deposited at the mobile NPC that coincides with your alignment.  Your pneuma
increase with each bottled soul deposited.  Pneuma have two ways of
contributing to your character's progress.  Primarily they are used when you
multiclass.  A certain number of pneuma are need to progress from level 30
to 31, 60 to 61, and 90 to 91.  (See 'Help Multiclass').  Pneuma can also be
deposited into your church's account, provided you're a member of a church.

helps.creator: Azrael
helps.text:
The reckoning is a very well known event to everyone far and wide.  This
happens then the daemon plane shifts into the normal plane, and throws the
entire world into complete chaos every blood moon. When this occurs, the
boundaries of the two worlds are torn and the chaos of the daemon plane
spills into this world.  The havoc extends to all regions of this world,
making nowhere but social a truly safe place to be.  People may fight each
other anywhere, and in safe you can be overcome with bloodlust, thus
attacking the nearest person to you at the time.  This duration is not for
the weak, but for the brave warrior.  There is said to be additional rewards
for killing others players and creatures of the world.  Be wary, as you hunt
others during this time, another may be hunting you.

This extremely powerful skill is known by all those who
have touched the power of a god and ascended into a higher
state of being. It does two things: call back the spirit of the
fallen to their corpse, and repairs their damaged body enough
for them to be able to sustain life on themselves. The magic
drains the life force of the user down as a result, leaving
them completely defenseless against any attack.

helps.text:
Alignment is your basic following in Sentience.
 
Malice  = negative alignment
Neutral = 0 alignment
Pious   = positive alignment
 
Malice followers are dedicated to chaos, and the most powerful
are also the most ruthless, insane with devotion to wreak harm
to the world. Some are only lackeys to the dark powers of Mishkal
while some can command the dark arts to whatever means they
desire.
 
Followers of Neutrality seek to avoid the war between the sides 
of light and dark and instead choose their own fate. However,
in their endeavours, the Neutral ones can side with either good 
or evil.
 
Followers of the Pious seek to bring order and harmony to the world,
stopping the deeds of the evil and protecting the weak and helpless.

helps.text:
The history is quite long and cannot quite yet be found on the Sentience web site.

The VERY brief overview is this:

There were a bunch of races living on two continents Seralia and Athemia.
There were some powerful warlocks who took on the wrong apprentice. He was 
a rather evil guy and killed lots of people. The warlocks gave up there powers
to have him banished to the demon plane. The world forgot about the evil
warlock and prospered until he was released again on the world. His minions
of undead killed everyone again. Some religious group rose from the ruins
of the crumbled Seralian Kingdom and forced the evil races back to Kaikemoire
and the corners of the Seralia. The evil warlocks name was Mishkal.
